First, we note that the position vector of $P$ is $p=⟨-2,3,1⟩.$  From the vectorial equation, we find that the line is parallel to the vector $⟨3,-5,2⟩.$  So, the normal vector of the plane is 

$$
n=⟨3,-5,2⟩.
$$

Using the dot product, we can find the equation of the plane as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}(r-p)\cdot n & =0 \\ r\cdot n & =p\cdot n \\ r\cdot ⟨3,-5,2⟩ & =⟨-2,3,1⟩\cdot ⟨3,-5,2⟩ \\ r\cdot ⟨3,-5,2⟩ & =-19\end{aligned}
$$

Now, to obtain the Cartesian equation of the plane, we substitute $r=⟨x,y,z⟩$ into the equation above. Hence,

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y,z⟩\cdot ⟨3,-5,2⟩ & =-19 \\ 3x-5y+2z & =-19 \\ 3x-5y+2z+19 & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
